name: Ankle Splint
desc: Used for immobilization of soft tissues of the ankle joint, Achilles tendon injuries and after orthopedic surgery.

name: Wrist Splint
desc: Used for fractures of the wrist or distal forearm, functional fixation of wrist arthroplasty and resting position braking or fixation of dislocation of the lunate and colles fracture of the wrist and other lesions.

name: Knee and Ankle Splint
desc: Used for immobilization of knee and ankle injuries, postoperative braking of knee and ankle joints and immobilization after orthopedic surgery.

name: Lumbar Splint
desc: Used for external fixation after spinal surgery, cerebral palsy and children scoliosis correction, spinal injury, etc., to maintain the physiological curvature of the spine, the use of lumbar spine spinal muscles and soft tissues to get enough rest.

name: Drop Foot Splint
desc: Use for immobilization of ankle soft tissues, Achilles tendon injuries and after orthopedic surgery, the double zipper design is easier to operate.

name: Elbow Splint
desc: Used for immobilization of elbow and wrist tendon, soft tissue and nerve injuries and postoperative fixation of the elbow joint; the double zipper design makes it easier to operate.
